title: Credit Suisse Backpack Stuffing Event 2018
description: Through Credit Suisse's annual Holiday Charity Initiative, $280,000 was raised to benefit Fallen Patriots' mission to support the college dreams of the nearly 20,000 kids left behind by troops killed in the line of duty over the past 35 years.    Learn more: https://www.fallenpatriots.org/press-releases/2018/12/19/credit-suisse-holiday-charity-initiative-makes-season-brighter-for-children-of-fallen-patriots-foundation

asr.full_text: We're here today with Children of Fallen. Patriots for backpacking event where we have. Volunteers with Secreted Swiss and we're. Packing backpacks that are sent for students. Who are part of Fallen Patriots and it's. Obviously you can tell we're pretty all. Excited about it and a good group of. People trying to help out you know a. Great cause. We're doing this to send out to some of our scholarship recipients who are all students. In college and basically we just send out these backpacks because we just like to remind. Our students that we're thinking of them. We're not just covering their financials, we're trying to cover everything that we can. My dad passed away in 2011 and I was 15. I was a freshman in high school. So one of the last things that was on my mind was how I was going to pay for college, but. But I could definitely see that it weighed on my mom pretty much every day. And I just remember when my mom discovered Fallen Patriots,. The relief when they told her what they were going to cover,. And she just couldn't believe it. And that's the same relief that I hear on mom's voices every day. When I talk to them on the phone. I do remember getting one of these backpacks. From my senior year of high school,. And I think what it meant to me was it was just a nice gesture. To see this isn't just a scholarship organization. It's just so all-encompassing, and it's really a support group. We're here to make sure that all of our students succeed and we're here in every way to support them.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it documents Credit Suisse volunteers packing backpacks for students supported by Children of Fallen Patriots. Its described purpose is educational and supportive, involving scholarships, counseling, and supplies rather than financial returns or requests for credentials or payment from viewers. The external informational link and stated fundraising amount do not by themselves establish a deceptive solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The main content is a human-interest account of a volunteer event and its meaning to scholarship recipients, rather than an operational tutorial or a commercial offer.

evidence.observation: A speaker describes sending backpacks to college-student scholarship recipients as a gesture of support.
